buildings.name: Habitat
buildings.purpose: Beds and recovery space for tired or hurt colonists.
buildings.impact: Adds 2 recovery beds before technology bonuses.

buildings.name: Mess Hall
buildings.purpose: Meal work that lowers the next daily supply draw.
buildings.impact: Lets cooks prepare meals and creates meal-time social contact.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.purpose: Builder work that converts wreckage into salvage.
buildings.impact: Lets builders recover salvage from the crash site.

buildings.name: Storage
buildings.purpose: Raises the supply cap and organizes hauling work.
buildings.impact: Adds supply capacity and lets haulers recover salvage.

buildings.name: Exploration Gate
buildings.purpose: Launches scans for tech items and emergency resources.
buildings.impact: Enables perimeter scans for resources, injuries, and technology items.

missions.name: Supply Run
missions.description: A fast salvage loop for food reserves and small wreckage caches.

missions.name: Perimeter Scan
missions.description: A cautious sweep that balances resources, mapping, and discoveries.

missions.name: Deep Survey
missions.description: A long push past the wreck perimeter for stronger research finds.

technology.name: Modular Habitats
technology.effect: Each Habitat can support one more sleeper.

technology.name: Hydroponic Planning
technology.effect: Daily supply need is reduced by one.

technology.name: Drone Survey
technology.effect: Mission danger and regroup time are reduced.

technology.name: Nutrient Culture
technology.effect: Daily supply need is reduced further.

technology.name: Hull Retrofits
technology.effect: Habitats and storage use wreckage more efficiently.

technology.name: Fabrication Jigs
technology.effect: Workshop and hauling salvage recovery improves.

menu_premise: Guide six crash survivors through the first week.
Build shelter, food, storage, repairs, and scouting routes.
Priorities shape work pressure, recovery, missions, and relationships.
menu_controls: Tap a control or release the mouse to interact.
Build, assign, launch missions, and restart from the visible controls.
Keyboard shortcuts remain available: Q W E R T, Z, Esc, 1 2 3, Space, M.
text.intro_building: BUILD: choose a room, then tap a clear tile to place it.
text.intro_assignments: ASSIGN: select a survivor and pin a home or work room.
text.intro_missions: MISSIONS: build an Exploration Gate, then launch a safe scan.
text.intro_restart: RESTART: use the visible Restart Run button after a failure or victory.
